data.headline: Sky Ranch easement-vacation item adopted in Arapahoe County

claims.text: The agenda records adoption of a resolution for Sky Ranch Filing 7 Easement Vacation.

citation.quote:
[Item 26] 26-502 | Resolution
VAC26-004 - Sky Ranch Filing 7 Easement Vacation
Action: adopted (Pass)

claims.text: PCYO says it acquired 828 acre-feet of water beneath Sky Ranch and uses it in its overall water system, including services to the community.

citation.quote: As part of the acquisition of the Sky Ranch land in 2010, we also acquired the 828 acre-feet of water located beneath the property. The water is being used as part of our overall water system, which includes providing services to the Sky Ranch Master Planned Community.

claims.text: PCYO says local authorities have broad discretion over approvals.

citation.quote: authorities often have broad discretion in exercising their approval authority.

claims.text: PCYO says its ability to obtain or renew permits or approvals depends on factors beyond its control.

citation.quote: our ability to obtain or renew permits or approvals and the continued effectiveness of permits already granted or approvals already obtained depends on factors beyond our control
